name: efebiskin/sec-form4-parser
what_it_holds: Pip-installable, dependency-free, typed Python parser for SEC Form 4 insider-trading XML filings (converts EDGAR Form 4 XML into structured transaction records: insider name, role, transaction date, shares, price). No data bundled — a parsing library only, to be pointed at EDGAR full-text/XBRL Form 4 filings.
why_useful: A clean building block for constructing an ABNB insider-transaction history (Form 4s already public on EDGAR) without hand-rolling XML parsing; could feed an insider-buying/selling signal panel alongside the existing guidance ledger.
time_coverage: method only; covers whatever EDGAR range is queried (EDGAR Form 4 history back to ~1996 in XML from ~2003)
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: A clean building block for constructing an ABNB insider-transaction history (Form 4s already public on EDGAR) without hand-rolling XML parsing; could feed an insider-buying/selling signal panel alongside the existing guidance ledger.

name: lucabol/FollowTheGuru
what_it_holds: 13F parsing and visualization tool for investor portfolios identified by CIK (pulls EDGAR 13F-HR filings, parses XML holdings tables, visualizes by manager). Very low activity (1 star, last updated 2021), no bundled dataset.
why_useful: A minimal reference implementation for parsing 13F-HR XML by CIK; could be adapted to build an institutional-ownership-concentration time series for ABNB (gap 15) but would need real rework given its age/inactivity.
time_coverage: method only, whatever EDGAR range queried (13F-HR filings since ABNB's 4Q20 IPO quarter onward)
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: A minimal reference implementation for parsing 13F-HR XML by CIK; could be adapted to build an institutional-ownership-concentration time series for ABNB (gap 15) but would need real rework given its age/inactivity.

name: mileshenrichs/openholdings
what_it_holds: Apache-2.0 Python package to "retrieve full ETF holdings lists with a single Python function" — a thin client presumably wrapping fund-provider holdings pages/APIs into one call. No bundled data.
why_useful: Lower-friction alternative to the iShares/SPDR-specific scrapers above if it covers multiple fund families in one interface; would need inspection to confirm ABNB-holding ETFs (consumer discretionary, travel, growth funds) are covered.
time_coverage: point-in-time pulls only, no history bundled
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: Lower-friction alternative to the iShares/SPDR-specific scrapers above if it covers multiple fund families in one interface; would need inspection to confirm ABNB-holding ETFs (consumer discretionary, travel, growth funds) are covered.

name: bdi2357/iShares_ETF_holdings_downloader
what_it_holds: Small MIT-licensed script for downloading iShares ETF holdings (simpler alternative to talsan/ishares, no AWS integration, 3 stars).
why_useful: Lightweight fallback method to the more complete talsan/ishares tool for the same purpose (pulling ABNB's weight in iShares consumer/growth funds).
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: Lightweight fallback method to the more complete talsan/ishares tool for the same purpose (pulling ABNB's weight in iShares consumer/growth funds).

name: tarikceric/Price-Trends-for-ARK-investments
what_it_holds: Tracks ARKK/ARKX (Cathie Wood ARK Invest) daily holdings-disclosure files (ARK publishes daily CSV holdings) with analysis in pandas and export to PostgreSQL. ARK's own daily-published CSVs are a genuine free historical daily-holdings source going back to ARK fund inception (~2014) if the repo or ARK's site is used directly.
why_useful: ARK funds are known to have held/traded growth-consumer names; a working daily-ARK-holdings puller/archiver is a real historical-frequency institutional-ownership proxy source (higher frequency than 13F) for whichever names it covers, worth checking if ABNB ever appeared in ARKK/ARKX baskets.
time_coverage: method only; ARK publishes daily CSVs historically back to fund inception if pulled/archived
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: ARK funds are known to have held/traded growth-consumer names; a working daily-ARK-holdings puller/archiver is a real historical-frequency institutional-ownership proxy source (higher frequency than 13F) for whichever names it covers, worth checking if ABNB ever appeared in ARKK/ARKX baskets.
